title: verb-nurbs-ts graph document, version 2
description: A node graph (docs/formats.md). Lengths in millimetres, angles in degrees.

number.title: Number
number.description: A parameter: other nodes read it by a wire or by its id in an expression

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: Any expression over number nodes, by their ids: h / 2 + wall

math.div.title: Divide
math.div.description: a / b; dividing by zero is an error

math.min.title: Minimum
math.min.description: the smaller of a and b

math.max.title: Maximum
math.max.description: the larger of a and b

math.clamp.title: Clamp
math.clamp.description: a held between min and max

freeform.revolve.title: Revolve
freeform.revolve.description: A solid of revolution about z, its radius a function of t from 0 at the base to 1 at the top: circles at the samples, lofted. A vase, a column, a bulb

radius.description: radius, an expression of t (0 to 1) and number nodes

freeform.pipe.title: Pipe
freeform.pipe.description: A round tube along the smooth curve through (x, y, z) at the samples of t from 0 to 1, capped at both ends: a tendril, a stem, a whiplash

x.description: x, an expression of t (0 to 1) and number nodes

y.description: y, an expression of t (0 to 1) and number nodes

z.description: z, an expression of t (0 to 1) and number nodes

freeform.prism.title: Prism
freeform.prism.description: An outline in the xy plane, extruded from z = 0 to its height. Points 'x, y' or 'x, y, r' (r rounds the corner), each value a number or an expression over number nodes. Any simple polygon: it is built as an exact extrusion. For curves, arcs and holes, Extrude profile

outline.description: outline: points "x, y; x, y, r; ...", millimetres; each value a number or an expression over number nodes; r rounds that corner

center.description: cap centre (no longer needed): points "x, y; x, y, r; ...", millimetres; each value a number or an expression over number nodes; r rounds that corner

freeform.vessel.title: Vessel
freeform.vessel.description: A pot from its drawn half-section, in millimetres from the base up: the outer profile turned about z, less the cavity (from its floor to above the rim) and the hollow under a foot

outer.description: outer: points "r z; r z; ...", millimetres, from the base up

cavity.description: cavity: points "r z; r z; ...", millimetres, from the base up; empty for none

foot.description: foot: points "r z; r z; ...", millimetres, from the base up; empty for none

profile.extrude.title: Extrude profile
profile.extrude.description: A planar profile (an outer path and holes: lines, three-point arcs, cubic Béziers, circles) extruded from z up by height, exact; the top turned by twist degrees and scaled by scaleTop about the z axis (helical and conical sides); faces bottom, top, outer.k and hole{i}.k for segment k

profile.description: profile: { outer, holes }, paths of lines, three-point arcs and cubic Béziers, or circles, in millimetres (docs/formats.md, Profiles)

profile.revolve.title: Revolve profile
profile.revolve.description: A profile drawn in the (r, z) half-plane, x the radius and y the height (lines, three-point arcs, cubic Béziers, circles), turned about the z axis, exact; a segment along the axis makes no face; faces outer.k for segment k

profile.description: profile: { outer, holes }, paths of lines, three-point arcs and cubic Béziers, or circles, in millimetres (docs/formats.md, Profiles)

transform.rotate.title: Rotate
transform.rotate.description: Rotate about an axis through the origin

transform.scale.title: Scale
transform.scale.description: Scale about the origin; negative mirrors

finish.round.title: Round edges
finish.round.description: Fillets or chamfers on the edges named by patterns, comma separated: box.*|box.*

finish.shell.title: Shell
finish.shell.description: Hollow the solid; faces named by patterns are left open

component.title: Component
component.description: An instance of another graph document (docs/formats.md, Components)
